title: The Decent job in the town
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：decent　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 decent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the musician wrote of ① a decent job in the town in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② more decent than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the decent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most decent job in the town anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too decent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the decent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a decent man at the counter, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as decent as the man at the counter they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was decent or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something decent, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite decent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the decent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another decent job in the town in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more decent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most decent man at the counter in the whole hall, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the decent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 体面（前置定语 a decent job in the town：1983 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件体面的正经工作）
B. adj. 体面／正派（比较级 more decent than：文中两处，一处比城里的正经工作，一处比预想）
C. adj. 体面／正派（最高级 the most decent：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 体面（表语 too decent to do：母亲觉得它太体面，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 正派（前置定语 a decent man at the counter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩正派的男人）
F. adj. 正派（同级比较 as decent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩柜台后的男人相比）
G. adj. 正派（后置定语 something decent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 正派（受程度副词修饰 quite decent：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a decent job in the town
the most decent job in the town anybody
a decent man at the counter
The most decent man at the counter in

answers.why: decent 意为“体面”，1983 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件体面的正经工作”，此处作前置定语 a decent job in the town。
decent 意为“体面”，此处用比较级 more decent than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
decent 意为“体面”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最体面的一件，故用最高级 the most decent job in the town。
decent 意为“体面”，母亲认为这件东西“太体面了，谁也用不上”，too decent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
decent 意为“正派”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩正派的男人”，此处作前置定语 a decent man at the counter。
decent 意为“正派”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩柜台后的男人一样正派”，同级比较用 as decent as。
decent 意为“正派”，节目单上那半行字要的是“正派的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something decent。
decent 意为“正派”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当正派”，quite 修饰原级 decent。
decent 意为“正派”，1993 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要正派”，故用比较级 more decent than。
decent 意为“正派”，母亲 1995 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最正派的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most decent man at the counter。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件体面的正经工作。（a decent job in the town）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更体面。（more decent than …）
母亲觉得它太体面，谁也用不上。（too decent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩正派的男人。（a decent man at the counter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩柜台后的男人一样正派。（as decent as …）
到了 1990 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件正派的东西。（something decent）
answers: In 1983 the musician wrote of a decent job in the town in the programme.
Everybody said it was more decent than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too decent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a decent man at the counter.
He said nobody would call it as decent as the man at the counter they had once had.
By 1990 the programme asked for nothing but something decent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 decent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the musician wrote of a decent job in the town in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most decent job in the town in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too decent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a decent man at the counter, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite decent, and everybody laughed.
The decent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
